answer_4.quote: We conducted a manual error analysis by selecting 100 records from each of the seven datasets (which will be discussed in detail later). The results revealed only six errors across the 700 records, yielding an overall error rate of 0.86%.
answer_4.guideline: We conducted a manual error analysis to better understand the failure cases of our best-performing system (Top+Clust+LogP, henceforth BEST) compared to the character-level sequence-to-sequence model (S2S) on the ATB dev set.
